text:
elaine: P1 from ACME — multiple users getting 403 when opening Project Settings (billing/roles tab) after we toggled role-propagation feature last night. ticket: #789412 :rotating_light:
acme-admin: Confirmed. We can list projects and make API calls with our service token, but UI -> Project Settings shows 'Permission denied (403)' for 3 human admins.
elaine: Important note: these three users are in an Okta group that was renamed during SCIM sync around 01:10 UTC. We toggled feature 'inheritance-v2' at 02:45 UTC.
samir: copying in identity. Do we know whether group UUIDs changed on SCIM side?
acme-admin: Okta showed group rename, yes. SCIM audit shows group update event with new displayName but same id.
maria: Customer says they can still access everything from CLI with their API key. Only console UI 403.
kevin: That suggests front-end authz lookup failing vs backend service call. Maybe a cache or permission resolution edge-case.
samir: Please grab a failing request from the browser console (network). We want the request to /api/console/v1/projects/<proj>/settings with response 403 and body.
acme-admin: pasted console snippet: 
```
GET /api/console/v1/projects/abc123/settings
authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...
response 403 {"error":"permission_denied","details":"user lacks role: project_admin (inherited flagged as shadow)"}
```
elaine: The error text 'inherited flagged as shadow' is interesting — sounds like the new propagation code is classifying the group's binding as 'shadow' and not applying it in UI checks.
samir: Can you also capture the /api/iam/v1/principals/<user>/effective-roles call response for a user that sees 403 vs one that doesn't?
acme-admin: here's two responses (sanitized):
```
user A: roles: ["viewer"]
user B: roles: ["project_admin","billing_admin"]
```
user B is an org owner but still got 403 in UI for the billing tab.
kevin: Hmm mismatch between effective roles from IAM and UI check. Could be front-end cached policy mapping to UI feature flags. Any JS errors?
acme-admin: console has this error intermittently: 
```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'canManageBilling' of undefined at ui-checks.js:120
```
maria: Customer wants workaround ASAP — what can we tell them?
elaine: Short-term: regen session (force re-auth) didn't help. But if they remove the renamed Okta group from the SCIM mapping and re-add (triggering a full group sync), UI access returns for one user. So resync helped in tests.
samir: That's actionable. I think the code path that marks 'shadow' binding relies on a cached membership fingerprint that includes group displayName and an internal feature flag. Renaming group may have produced a stale fingerprint mismatch that the propagation job later treats as 'shadow' and doesn't materialize to UI permission indexes.
kevin: I'll wire a hotfix: ensure UI permission checks fall back to IAM effective roles when index shows shadow. That will remove the 403 while we fix propagation indexing. Patching 02:00 UTC.
samir: For triage we need steps to repro in staging: 1) create org and project 2) create Okta group G with name "Proj Admins" 3) map SCIM group -> org role project_admin 4) open console to verify access 5) rename group in Okta (displayName) 6) run SCIM sync 7) toggle inheritance-v2 feature and run propagation job -> observe UI 403 for members.
elaine: I'll add those to the ticket and ask ACME to perform full SCIM group re-sync as workaround.
acme-admin: We're running the resync now. Will confirm in ~10m.
samir: Also capturing logs for propagation job: 
```
[2026-03-17T02:46:03Z] propagation:project=abc123 job=inheritance-v2 seed=okta:GROUP:00A1 status=skipped reason=membership_fingerprint_mismatch
[2026-03-17T02:46:04Z] propagation:project=abc123 job=inheritance-v2 created_shadow_binding id=sb-7f4
```
kevin: That 'created_shadow_binding' is the bug: shadow bindings should be rejected or materialized, not left dangling. I'll change the propagation job to attempt reconciliation immediately when fingerprint mismatch occurs.
maria: ETA for hotfix?
kevin: I'll push a guarded patch to staging in 20m and to prod in 2 hours if green. Rolling update to avoid impacting other tenants.
elaine: Customer update queued: explain cause (group rename + propagation race), provide resync workaround and ETA for fix.
acme-admin: Resync completed — two users regained access. One still 403, clearing cookies + logout/login fixed it. Thanks.
samir: Good. Postmortem actions: (1) add reconciliation path for shadow bindings, (2) improve SCIM rename handling so fingerprint uses immutable group id only, (3) add monitoring alert when propagation job creates shadow bindings.
kevin: I'll open an eng-infra PR and a SRE runbook for rolling the fix.
elaine: I'll mark ticket #789412 as mitigated pending prod rollout. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
